name: bijectors
title: Bijections between distributions
summary: A Normal through exp is a log-normal; a coupling layer turns a Gaussian into a banana. The density stays exact.
alt: A Normal, the map exp, the log-normal it gives, and a coupling layer turning a Gaussian into a banana

name: decision-tree
title: A decision tree and the regions it cuts
summary: A classification tree on two iris measurements, drawn by the library as its splits and as the regions of the plane.
alt: A decision tree on iris petal length and width, drawn as a tree of splits beside the regions of the plane it makes

name: optimisers
title: Optimisers, first and second order
summary: Gradient descent, momentum and Adam against BFGS, L-BFGS and Newton on the Rosenbrock function: the paths and the loss from the recorded runs.
alt: Six optimisers on the Rosenbrock function: their paths over the function and the loss against the step on a log axis

name: session
title: Pause, jump back, compare with the truth
summary: A support vector classifier as a session: its decision surface at step 3 and at the end, and the best possible accuracy.
alt: The decision surface of a support vector classifier at step 3 and at the end

name: svm
title: Support vectors and the margin
summary: A kernel support vector classifier with a small and a large C: the score, the boundary, the margins and the support vectors.
alt: Two support vector classifiers on the two-moons data: the score as a heat map with the boundary and margins as contours, and the support vectors ringed

name: bandit
title: Which arm to pull
summary: Epsilon-greedy, UCB1 and Thompson sampling on a five-armed bandit: the regret curves and how often each arm was pulled.
alt: Cumulative regret of three bandit strategies over 400 pulls, and the number of pulls of each of the five arms

name: changepoints
title: Finding the moment a stream changes
summary: Bayesian online changepoint detection read back from its tape: the stream, its prediction, and the belief about how long the current stretch has lasted.
alt: A stream whose mean shifts twice with the changes a detector found, its prediction, and the run-length belief over time and at one step

name: clustering
title: A Gaussian mixture, step by step
summary: Expectation-maximisation for three overlapping Gaussians: the density, the log likelihood and the soft assignments.
alt: A Gaussian mixture fitted by EM: the density it gives the plane with the rows coloured by component, and the log likelihood over the steps

name: embedding
title: Handwritten digits in two dimensions
summary: 600 handwritten digits, each 64 numbers, placed on a plane by PCA, t-SNE and UMAP and coloured by the digit.
alt: The same 600 handwritten digits placed on a plane by PCA, t-SNE and UMAP, each point coloured by its digit

name: fourier
title: A drawing from rotating circles
summary: A closed curve as the sum of turning circles: its Fourier coefficients, chained tip to tip, draw it again.
alt: A chain of rotating circles whose tip traces a heart-shaped curve

name: gam-neural
title: A neural additive model, from its spline bases
summary: A learnable spline with no smoothness penalty: the weighted basis functions and their sum come up to the points as it trains (learning.gif).
alt: A spline fitted with no smoothness penalty: its weighted basis functions and their sum against the data, the truth and the classic GAM, and the training loss

name: gp
title: A Gaussian process, tuned by a gradient
summary: grad of the marginal likelihood written as a plain function, and a Gaussian process fitted on that gradient.
alt: A Gaussian process on noisy sine data, before and after its hyperparameters are learned, each with its uncertainty band

name: kalman
title: Tracking a moving target
summary: A Kalman filter following a target round a circle through noisy position readings, one reading at a time.
alt: A target going round a circle, its noisy readings and the estimate of a Kalman filter following it

name: logistic
title: Bayesian logistic regression, approximated four ways
summary: The weight posterior by NUTS, Laplace and two variational fits, and the predicted probability beside the true boundary.
alt: The weight posterior of a Bayesian logistic regression by NUTS, Laplace and two variational fits, and the predicted probability with the true boundary

name: lorenz
title: Chaos: nearby paths part
summary: The Lorenz equations from seven starting points one part in a thousand apart: the paths separate and follow different turns of the butterfly.
alt: Seven paths of the Lorenz system started a hair apart, seen from the front, with fading tails

name: neural-network
title: A small neural network, trained and watched
summary: A multilayer perceptron on the two moons: the loss at every step, and the decision surface at the start, the middle and the end.
alt: The training loss of a small network on two moons, and its decision surface at the start, the middle and the end of training

name: newton
title: Second order: grad of grad, Hessians and Newton
summary: grad(grad(f)), hessian and hvp; Newton reaches the minimum in 12 steps where gradient descent needs 2662.
alt: Newton's path against gradient descent on the Rosenbrock function, with the curvature at two points

name: ode
title: Predators and prey, from an equation
summary: The Lotka-Volterra differential equations solved with an adaptive ODE solver: the two populations, the loop they trace, and the step sizes the solver chose.
alt: Prey and predator populations over time, the closed loop they trace in the prey and predator plane, and the solver step size against time

name: pca
title: Principal components of the iris data
summary: PCA found one component per step: the flowers in the first two components, the variance each explains, the loadings.
alt: PCA of the iris data: the rows in the plane of the first two components coloured by species, the variance explained and the loadings

name: prolog
title: A logic program and its proof search
summary: A small Prolog family database; the query is answered by SLD resolution and the search tree is drawn from the run.
alt: The search tree of the query grandparent(tom, W): the answers, and the branches that fail and backtrack

name: qlearning
title: An agent learning
summary: Q-learning on the cliff-walking gridworld: the return of each episode, drawn from the recorded run.
alt: Episode returns while Q-learning learns to walk along the cliff

name: roc
title: The metrics of a classifier
summary: The ROC curve, the precision-recall curve, the precision-recall gain curve and the contingency table of a support vector classifier on held-out data.
alt: The ROC, precision-recall and precision-recall gain curves of a classifier, and its contingency table with totals and rates

name: sampler
title: A sampler on a banana
summary: NUTS on a twisted Gaussian: the draws over the true density, the trace of one coordinate, R-hat and effective sample size.
alt: Draws of four NUTS chains over the contours of the banana density, and the trace of the first coordinate

name: samplers
title: A random walk against Hamiltonian Monte Carlo
summary: Two samplers on a twisted density: a random walk takes blind steps, Hamiltonian Monte Carlo follows the slope.
alt: The draws of a random-walk sampler and of Hamiltonian Monte Carlo over the contours of a banana-shaped density

name: sat
title: Two SAT solvers on a hard puzzle
summary: Six pigeons cannot each have their own hole in five holes. Two SAT solvers, DPLL and CDCL, both prove it, and their traces differ.
alt: Conflicts and decision level against steps for the DPLL and CDCL solvers on the pigeonhole formula with six pigeons and five holes
